status: issued for coordination under D-066; primary-bathroom waterproofing, drainage, ventilation, privacy and detailed MEP remain open; not for construction

change.summary: Unify the two primary-bathroom zones as one L-shaped room, remove the full intermediate wall and door, and coordinate one non-duplicated fixture programme.

primary_bathroom_unified.planning_rule: Treat M-B-A and M-B only as a parametric tessellation of one L-shaped bathroom; the complete 2.40 m shared edge is open and has no door leaf.
primary_bathroom_unified.net_area_basis: Schematic net area calculated from the L-shaped gross area with a 0.10 m inward wet-wall allowance around its 19.80 m perimeter: 17.60 - (0.10 x 19.80) + 0.04 = 15.66 m2.
